title: Announcements and Invitations
ringkas: Teks fungsional pendek: pengumuman, undangan, dan pesan
goals: memakai ungkapan: [[We are pleased to announce ...]], [[You are invited to ...]], [[Please come ...]]
menerima dan menolak undangan dengan sopan
memakai [[will be held]], [[on + hari/tanggal]], [[at + jam/tempat]] dengan benar
menulis pengumuman, undangan, dan pesan pendek yang jelas

lesson.text: Papan pengumuman sekolah, undangan ulang tahun di grup WhatsApp, pesan singkat dari guru: semuanya adalah **teks fungsional pendek**. Teks ini ditulis singkat, jelas, dan memuat **informasi penting** saja. Di kelas 9 kamu sudah mengenalnya. Sekarang kamu belajar membaca dan menulisnya dengan lebih lengkap.

lesson.title: 1. Tiga jenis teks pendek
table: memberi tahu informasi kepada banyak orang
[[The library will be closed on Friday.]]
[[You are invited to my birthday party.]]
[[Mom, I will be late. Don't wait for me.]]

items.ex: The school announces a new schedule.
I invite you to my party.
All students must attend the meeting.
The meeting will be held in the hall.
The venue is the school field.
Please bring your own water bottle.
The match was cancelled because of rain.
The picnic is postponed until next week.
Check the lost and found box.

lesson.title: 4. Ungkapan yang sering dipakai
table: [[We are pleased to announce that the contest will be held on Friday.]]
[[You are invited to our school anniversary.]]
[[Don't forget to bring your ID card.]]

lesson.title: Preposisi waktu dan tempat
lesson.text: Pakai [[on]] untuk hari dan tanggal ([[on Monday]], [[on 5 May]]), [[at]] untuk jam dan tempat spesifik ([[at 8 a.m.]], [[at the school hall]]), dan [[in]] untuk bulan, tahun, atau ruangan ([[in June]], [[in Room 5]]).

lesson.title: 5. Menerima dan menolak undangan
table: [[Thank you for inviting me. I would love to come.]] / [[Sure, I'll be there.]]
[[Thank you for inviting me, but I'm afraid I can't come.]]
[[I have a family event that day.]]

lines.en: We are pleased to announce that an English Speech Contest will be held on Saturday, 15 March, at 9 a.m. in the school hall.
lines.id: Dengan senang hati kami mengumumkan bahwa Lomba Pidato Bahasa Inggris akan diadakan pada hari Sabtu, 15 Maret, pukul 9 pagi di aula sekolah.

lines.en: The contest is open to all students of Grade 10. Please register to Ms. Sari before Wednesday.
lines.id: Lomba terbuka untuk semua siswa kelas 10. Silakan mendaftar kepada Ms. Sari sebelum hari Rabu.

lines.en: Don't forget to bring your student card.
You are invited to Rani's 16th birthday party!
lines.id: Kamu diundang ke pesta ulang tahun ke-16 Rani!

lines.en: Date: Sunday, 23 June. Time: 4 p.m. Place: Rani's house, 12 Melati Street.
lines.id: Tanggal: Minggu, 23 Juni. Waktu: pukul 4 sore. Tempat: rumah Rani, Jalan Melati 12.

lines.en: Please wear something blue. There will be food, games, and music.
lines.id: Mohon kenakan sesuatu berwarna biru. Akan ada makanan, permainan, dan musik.

lines.en: RSVP to Rani by Thursday. See you there!
lines.id: Konfirmasi ke Rani sebelum hari Kamis. Sampai jumpa di sana!

lines.en: Budi, I went to the market. Lunch is in the fridge. Please heat it before you eat. Don't forget to feed the cat. I'll be back at 3 p.m.
lines.id: Budi, Ibu pergi ke pasar. Makan siang ada di kulkas. Tolong panaskan sebelum makan. Jangan lupa memberi makan kucing. Ibu pulang pukul 3 sore.

lines.en: Tom, I'm having a small party on Sunday at four. Can you come?
lines.id: Tom, aku mengadakan pesta kecil hari Minggu pukul empat. Bisa datang?

lines.en: Thank you for inviting me, Dina. I would love to come, but I'm afraid I have a football match that day.
lines.id: Terima kasih sudah mengundangku, Dina. Aku ingin sekali datang, tetapi sayangnya aku ada pertandingan sepak bola hari itu.

lines.en: That's okay. Good luck with your match!
lines.id: Tidak apa-apa. Semoga berhasil di pertandinganmu!

lines.en: Thanks. I hope the party goes well.

lesson.title: Membaca teks pendek dengan cepat
lesson.text: Cari dulu **kata kunci**: hari, tanggal, jam, tempat, dan nomor telepon. Setelah itu baca perintah seperti [[Please bring ...]], [[Don't forget ...]], dan [[RSVP ...]]. Menulis pun begitu: mulai dari informasi yang paling penting.

items: Informasi penting: **what, when, where, who**, dan kontak.
Ungkapan: [[We are pleased to announce ...]], [[You are invited to ...]], [[Don't forget to ...]].
[[on]] untuk hari/tanggal, [[at]] untuk jam/tempat, [[in]] untuk bulan/ruangan.
Menolak undangan: [[Thank you for inviting me, but I'm afraid I can't come.]]
